mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased corporate costs within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2 million units signals strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST > 1200 does not correlate with economic growth within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with negative economic indicators within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2% year-over-year, it signals a supportive monetary policy in a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high GDPC1 growth does not lead to positive market returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not correlate with economic growth within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS 3-month increase does not correlate with economic growth within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below the historical average signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below historical average, or FEDFUNDS below historical average does not correlate with accommodative monetary policy.
